jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.

  

As a Data Engineer, you will develop and maintain reliable, observable, and scalable data pipelines to support Materialise Medical’s analytics and reporting needs. You will help ensure data is processed accurately and consistently, working closely with software engineering teams, analytics consumers, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain data processing pipelines and data products, supporting analytics and operational reporting.
* Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, investigate data issues, and improve platform reliability.
* Implement automated validation, reconciliation, and quality monitoring to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
* Work with AWS services such as Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, and DMS.
* Collaborate with analytics teams, software engineers, and data consumers to support trusted and usable data products.
Contribute to monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of data platform reliability and engineering practices.  

  

Requirements

Essential:

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Programming or scripting experience, preferably Python.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.

Preferred:

* Experience with software testing, data testing, or automated quality assurance practices.
* Experience in data engineering, data integration, or data processing.
* Knowledge of SQL, databases, and ETL/ELT concepts.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.  

  

**What’s waiting for you**

**Work that matters**  
The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

**A people-centered space**  
When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

**An environment of trust**  
As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

**A career ready to build**  
When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.

**Company:** DLL Builtech (M) Sdn Bhd

Position Summary

The **Civil & Structural (C&S) Engineer** is responsible for overseeing the structural design compliance, technical execution, quality control, and site engineering operations across DLL Builtech’s building, civil works, and infrastructure projects (including specialized commercial builds, healthcare facilities, and industrial developments). The role serves as a key technical liaison between design consultants, client representatives, sub-contractors, and site teams to ensure works comply with contractual specifications, Malaysia PWD / PAM standards, CIDB requirements, and safety regulations.

Key Responsibilities

* **Technical & Structural Execution:** Oversee site delivery of reinforced concrete (RC), steel frameworks, foundation systems, and deep structural elements to ensure compliance with approved construction drawings and technical specifications.
* **Design & Shop Drawing Review:** Evaluate C&S consultant drawings, trade shop drawings, and structural calculations; identify design clashes or site constructability issues early and issue Requests for Information (RFIs).
* **IBS & Formwork Optimization:** Coordinate and monitor implementation of Industrialised Building System (IBS) modular components, advanced formwork (e.g., Doka systems), and shoring solutions to optimize CIDB scoring and structural progress.
* **Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC):** Conduct structural inspections for rebar, concrete pours, formwork stability, structural steel alignments, and waterproofing applications. Manage mock-ups, cube testing, and structural integrity verifications.
* **Authority & Subcontractor Coordination:** Work closely with resident engineers (RE), clerks of works (COW), civil consultants, and sub-contractors to obtain structural clearance approvals at key project hold points.
* **Progress & Technical Reporting:** Prepare weekly/monthly technical status reports, method statements (MOS), structural progress updates, and site QA/QC documentation for project directors and client management.

Job Requirements & Qualifications1. Education & Professional Registration

* **Degree:** Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or equivalent from an accredited institution.
* **Professional Accreditation:** Registered as a Graduate Engineer with the **Board of Engineers Malaysia (BEM)**; IEM membership is a distinct advantage.

2. Experience

* **General Experience:** Minimum 1 **to 5 years** of hands-on site experience in civil and structural construction projects in Malaysia.
* **Sector Exposure:** Experience handling building works (residential/commercial), medical infrastructure, or specialized industrial developments. Direct exposure to PWD Design & Build or PAM standard contracts is preferred.

3. Technical & Software Competencies

* **Structural Software:** Proficiency in structural modeling/analysis software (e.g., STAAD.Pro, ETABS, Tekla) and drafting tools (**AutoCAD**). Knowledge of BIM/Revit is an advantage.
* **Standards & Codes:** Sound knowledge of Malaysian Standard Code of Practice (MS), British Standards (BS), Eurocodes, and CIDB IBS standards.
* **Methods:** Familiarity with heavy concrete casting, deep foundation/piling systems, modular formwork systems, and specialized waterproofing protocols.

4. Personal Attributes & Soft Skills

* Strong technical problem-solving, site coordination, and structural troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication in English and Bahasa Malaysia (written and spoken).
* Proactive site management capabilities with high attention to structural safety, quality compliance, and project deadlines.

Pay: From RM3,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person
